entities.summary: Ruth Graves Wakefield was an American chef, entrepreneur, and cookbook author whose culinary innovation transformed global baking culture. She is best known as the inventor of the chocolate chip cookie, a creation that has become one of the most recognizable and widely consumed desserts in the world.¹
